name: comprehensive_benchmark_rentacar
description: Comprehensive benchmark for a rentacar dataset. Default: geometric adstock only. Tests cartesian product of 3 dimensions: train_splits × time_aggregation × spend_var_mapping (18 variants). Use run_full_benchmark.py --all-adstock to also sweep weibull_cdf and weibull_pdf (54 variants total). Designed for datasets with Google Search (brand/non-brand/pmax/display/video), Meta, Bing, Facebook sub-channels, CRM/newsletter organic channels, and context variables such as rentacar availability, occupancy and location count. Dependent variable is typically 'bookings', 'gmv_net_eur', or 'gmv_gross_eur'.

adstock.name: geometric
adstock.description: Geometric adstock (default — use --all-adstock to also test weibull_cdf and weibull_pdf)

spend_var_mapping.name: spend_to_spend
spend_var_mapping.description: All channels: spend → spend (direct cost impact). paid_media_vars equals paid_media_spends.

spend_var_mapping.name: spend_to_impressions
spend_var_mapping.description: All channels: spend → impressions (ad delivery proxy). Column order must match paid_media_spends in selected_columns.json.

spend_var_mapping.name: spend_to_clicks
spend_var_mapping.description: All channels: spend → clicks (engagement proxy). Column order must match paid_media_spends in selected_columns.json.

spend_var_mapping.name: mixed_by_funnel_impressions
spend_var_mapping.description: Upper funnel (video, display, social) → impressions; lower funnel (brand/non-brand search, pmax, bing) → spend. Column order must match paid_media_spends in selected_columns.json.

spend_var_mapping.name: mixed_by_funnel_clicks
spend_var_mapping.description: Upper funnel (video, display, social) → clicks; lower funnel (brand/non-brand search, pmax, bing) → spend. Column order must match paid_media_spends in selected_columns.json.
